title: the shortest swords
description: say no more to swords blocking your screen during pvp
body:
(this pack is a joke and not really meant to be taken seriously)

a pack to stop your sword from blocking your screen during pvp, as soon as you play with this pack you'll go "wow, I can finally see my hole screen!".
!["wow"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/96e5650a1437b57e2f9930cc6aad3a05a9d259d6.png)

you truely cannot beat this texture pack, my playtesters (me, myself and I) have not been able to play without it since they first tried it!

the pack removes the annoying long bladed swords from vanilla that block your hole screen, in favour of a bladless sword for maximum vision.

this pack goes the extra mile compared to other short sword packs, because I thought, why do we even need the blade!

![all items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f39b092f8a66f2606d5d8f7c2f85c266af412510.png)

![player holding a sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b078d3a6ec94bf4155cbaa0e3b6ccc168590145.png)
